name: No Knockback Resistance
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Lumareth
description: A mod that removes knockback resistance from Minecraft to make Maces and windcharges work on full potential while wearing netherite or blast protection armor.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
